records.text: The commenter displayed as Not Nona / Nona's fave five, identity unverified, wrote that the behavior of Blake Neff, Andrew Kolvet and Erika Kirk made it seem almost as though they did not want facts about what happened to Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Not Nona / Nona’s fave five (commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Not Nona, Nona's fave five: "Candace, I'm so confused with the behavior of Blake Neff, Andrew Kolvet and Erika Kirk. It's almost like they don't want facts about what happened to Charlie (Charlie Kirk). Blink twice if I am close, lol. Enjoy the little one. God bless you and yours."
